name: motion-erp
description: Motion ERP — configurable, multi-company enterprise resource planning platform

scripts.dev: pnpm run shared:build && pnpm --recursive --parallel --stream run dev
scripts.dev:api: pnpm run shared:build && pnpm --filter @motion-erp/api run dev
scripts.dev:web: pnpm run shared:build && pnpm --filter @motion-erp/web run dev
scripts.build: pnpm run shared:build && pnpm --recursive --filter=!@motion-erp/shared run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run shared:build && pnpm --recursive run typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm run shared:build && pnpm --recursive run test
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm run shared:build && pnpm --filter @motion-erp/api run test:e2e
scripts.test:db: pnpm run shared:build && pnpm --filter @motion-erp/api run test:db
scripts.verify: pnpm run format:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test
